_was: Der Vergleichsmassstab der Registrierungs-Dateien (BUILD-SPEC v1 [REV6-1](ii), [REV7-3], [REV5-6]). Jede Sektion traegt ihre Herkunft und ihr Datum. Aenderungen nur ueber tests/druckenmiller/fixtures/registration.CHANGELOG.md (Muster [REV3-5]).

councilD3._origin: Council verdict 2026-09-14 03:53, decision D3 (logger constants) and D4 (universe U) — COUNCIL-VERDICT-2026-09-14.md

l4.unassignedRule: every other sector value, and a missing sector, goes into a VISIBLE 'unassigned' bucket (l4Unassigned) — never dropped, never reassigned

councilD3.l4bMatch: case-insensitive substring match on the provider's industry string

universe.redefinition: any redefinition is a NEW series id

courtGates._origin: Court retrial conditions 2026-09-14 — freshness gate from round 1 as amended by retrial N2, churn gate from BUILD-SPEC v1 [REV6-4]/[REV10-4]
courtGates._kind: data-quality exclusions, fixed before a single scoreboard entry exists — NOT outcome parameters (BUILD-SPEC v1 [REV8-5])
courtGates.freshnessConsequence: freshShare < 0.95 -> lowFreshness: true, the row stays in the series but feeds no quantile window and no H-INT; guard annotation is YELLOW, never a red run; backfilled rows carry freshShare null and are exempt from the gate
courtGates.churnFormula: (nEntered + nLeft) / nUniverse against the previous publication day
courtGates.churnConsequence: highChurn: true -> excluded from quantile windows like lowFreshness, and the session writes no scoreboard entries

overrideNoteD1._origin: Council verdict 2026-09-14 03:53, decision D1 (68 %) — the hashed override note required by BUILD-SPEC v1 §0.3
overrideNoteD1.text: Kipp-Schwelle (< 5 Prinzipien) gerissen: strenge Zaehlung 4, nach Advocatus Diaboli 3. Die Konsequenz wurde nach der vorgegebenen Eskalation (prinzipien-katalog.md:27-28) bewusst auf "kein eigenes Ranking" verengt.

rIntLoggedOnly._origin: Council D3 plus laneC/operationalisierung.md §2 — computed and logged, never published as a state
rIntLoggedOnly.aggregation: equal-weight mean of the legs' percentile ranks in the expanding window
rIntLoggedOnly.stateMachineNote: no state is published (Council D3), so no state machine runs; q30/q70 and the 20-session debounce are registered anyway so that a state can never be tuned into existence after the fact
